findings.description: The constructor declaration does not initialize all private members.
The constructor accepts an int16_t pin parameter. If a negative or out-of-range value is passed, it could cause undefined behavior when used with Arduino pin functions.
If _lastDebounceTime is manipulated without care, it could wrap around.
Using int16_t for pin numbers is not standard for Arduino (which typically uses uint8_t). This could lead to negative pin numbers being accepted.
Lack of documentation can lead to misuse or misunderstanding of the class.
